title: Multi-interface synergistic photocatalytic 2D/0D/2D TiO2/Pd/Ti3C2 heterojunctions for boosting hydrogen production
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40056-40066
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06368J, Paper

Huimin Jia, Ya Wang, Yiting Yang, Chuang Liu, Weiwei He
TiO2/Pd/Ti3C2 nanocomposite with 2D/0D/2D heterojunctions were fabricated to exhibit significantly enhanced photocatalytic H2 evolution through constructing a multi-interface synergistic catalytic system.
